Hi! I am currently first-year Ph.D. Student at Duke University, rotating with Dr. Felipe De Brigard. I have a strong passion for research and am always seeking opportunities to expand my knowledge and skills. I am broadly interested in moral cognition, computational modeling of cognitive processes, and data science.
:::
